notes.title: Big Update!
notes.content:
We have just made a big update for Unfair Jousting Fair:

New Singleplayer Arcade mode where you must face all the characters, one after another.
New characters: we added the two main characters from AlPixel Games' Missing Translation as playable characters.
New game modes: some of the old game modes that were selectable through activation/deactivation of objects are now selectable from the game menu, and there are some new modes, like olympic and street jousting.
New music, for the new modes!
And more fun!
